task: KITCHEN SCENE3 turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it

subtasks.action: Move the robotic arm from the bottom center towards the stove knob on the right.
Descend and close the gripper to grasp the stove knob.
Rotate the knob to the right to turn on the stove, causing the burner to glow red.
Open the gripper to release the knob and retract the arm to the left.
Move the arm to the moka pot and close the gripper to grasp its handle.
Lift the moka pot and transport it to the right, aligning it above the stove burner.
Lower the moka pot onto the burner and open the gripper to release it.

task: KITCHEN SCENE4 put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it

subtasks.action: Move the robotic arm from the bottom center towards the black bowl on the table to the left.
Descend and close the gripper to grasp the black bowl.
Lift the black bowl and transport it to the right towards the open cabinet.
Lower the black bowl into the open cabinet drawer.
Open the gripper to release the black bowl inside the drawer.
Retract the robotic arm upwards and away from the cabinet.

task: KITCHEN SCENE6 put the yellow and white mug in the microwave and close it

subtasks.action: Move the robotic arm from the bottom center towards the yellow and white mug on the counter.
Align the open gripper directly above the yellow and white mug.
Descend and close the gripper to grasp the mug by its handle.
Lift the mug and transport it to the right towards the open microwave.
Lower the mug into the microwave cavity and open the gripper to release it.
Retract the arm from the microwave and move towards the open door.
Push the microwave door closed with the arm.

task: KITCHEN SCENE8 put both moka pots on the stove

subtasks.action: Left arm moves upward and forward to approach the first moka pot on the counter.
Left arm descends and closes its gripper to grasp the first moka pot.
Left arm lifts the first moka pot and transports it to the left side of the stove.
Left arm lowers the first moka pot onto the left burner and releases it.
Left arm retracts, and the right arm moves forward to approach the second moka pot.
Right arm descends and closes its gripper to grasp the second moka pot.
Right arm lifts the second moka pot and transports it to the right side of the stove.
Right arm lowers the second moka pot onto the right burner and releases it.
Right arm retracts upward and away from the stove.

Descend and close the gripper to grasp the blue can.
Lift the blue can and transport it to the right towards the basket.
Lower the blue can into the basket and open the gripper to release it.
Retract the arm and move towards the small blue box in the center.
Descend and close the gripper to grasp the small blue box.
Lift the blue box and transport it to the right towards the basket.
Lower the blue box into the basket and open the gripper to release it.

Descend and close the gripper to grasp the blue box.
Lift the blue box and transport it to the right toward the basket.
Lower the blue box into the basket and open the gripper to release it.

task: LIVING ROOM SCENE5 put the white mug on the left plate and put the yellow and white mug on the right plate

subtasks.action: Left arm approaches the white mug from the left and closes its gripper to grasp the handle.
Left arm lifts the white mug and transports it to the left side of the table.
Left arm lowers the white mug onto the left plate and opens the gripper to release it.
Left arm retracts away from the plate while the right arm moves into position to approach the yellow and white mug.
Right arm closes its gripper to grasp the handle of the yellow and white mug.
Right arm lifts the yellow and white mug and transports it to the right side of the table.
Right arm lowers the yellow and white mug onto the right plate and opens the gripper to release it.

task: LIVING ROOM SCENE6 put the white mug on the plate and put the chocolate pudding to the right of the plate

subtasks.action: Move the open gripper towards the white mug on the left and align above it.
Descend and close the gripper to grasp the white mug.
Lift the white mug and transport it towards the plate.
Align the mug over the plate and lower it.
Release the mug onto the plate and retract the arm upwards.
Move the arm towards the brown box on the right and align above it.
Descend and close the gripper to grasp the brown box.

task: STUDY SCENE1 pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy

subtasks.action: Move the arm from the bottom right towards the black book on the table.
Align the gripper directly above the book and descend to make contact.
Close the gripper to grasp the book.
Lift the book vertically off the table surface.
Transport the book to the left, positioning it over the back compartment of the caddy.
Lower the book into the compartment and open the gripper to release it.
Retract the arm upwards and away from the caddy.
